docs.title: Welcome to GeoCore Documentation
docs.text: GeoCore is an advanced open-source geotechnical desktop app powered by Groundhog, FastAPI, React, and Electron.

docs.title: Quick Links
docs.text:

  • 💻 Source Code Repository
  • 📦 Packaging & Release Guide

docs.title: Deep Foundations
docs.text:
• LCPC Method (Bustamante & Gianeselli): CPT-based axial pile capacity.
  • Koppejan Method: Base and shaft resistance calculation with NaN-safe window filtering.
  • De Beer Method: Eurocode 7 compliant pile resistance from CPT data.
  • Axial Capacity (AxCap): Compression & tension capacity curves.
  • Negative Skin Friction: Zeevaert & De Beer single/group pile calculations.

docs.title: Eurocode 7
docs.text:
• Parameter selection (Constant values & linear trend analysis).
  • Partial factors calculator for STR/GEO limit states.

docs.title: AGS Converter
docs.text: • Native parser for AGS v3.1 & v4 site investigation files.

docs.title: GeoCore System Architecture
docs.text:
GeoCore is designed around a decoupled, microservice-inspired desktop architecture.

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       Electron Shell                        │
│   (Main Process: electron/main.cjs -> Preload: preload.js)  │
└──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                               │ IPC / Subprocess Control
                               ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    React Web Application                    │
│   (Vite + React 19 + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + Plotly) │
└──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                               │ HTTP REST API (port 8000)
                               ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 Python FastAPI Engine (Uvicorn)             │
│   (Registry -> Router -> Wrappers -> Groundhog Library)     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

docs.title: Backend Component Architecture
docs.text:
1. main.py: Entry point starting Uvicorn server on 127.0.0.1:8000.
  2. core/registry.py: Scans the groundhog package and dynamic schemas, registering execution endpoints.
  3. core/router.py: Dynamic FastAPI routing mapping front-end JSON payloads to Python wrapper functions.
  4. core/state.py: In-memory and disk state manager persisting SoilProfile and CalculationGrid objects across sessions.
  5. core/manual_functions.py: User extension directory allowing custom Python algorithms to be added on the fly.

docs.title: Developer Packaging & Executable Generation Guide
docs.text: This guide documents how to compile, bundle, and package GeoCore into native executables.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text: GeoCore packages a Python FastAPI backend into a single executable using PyInstaller, and embeds it inside an Electron shell using electron-builder.

docs.title: 1. PyInstaller Spec Configuration
docs.text:
The Python backend is packaged via python-backend/main.spec:

cd python-backend
pyinstaller --clean main.spec

docs.title: 2. Electron Packaging
docs.text:
cd electron-app

# Windows Installer (.exe)
npm run dist:win

# macOS Installer (.dmg)
npm run dist:mac

docs.title: 3. GitHub Actions Release Pipeline
docs.text: Pushes to git release tags (v*) automatically trigger .github/workflows/release.yml to compile binaries on Windows (windows-latest) and macOS (macos-latest) runners and publish them directly to GitHub Releases.

docs.title: AGS File Converter
docs.text: GeoCore includes an automated parser for AGS (Association of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Specialists) data files.

docs.title: Supported Formats
docs.text:
• AGS 3.1
  • AGS 4.0

docs.title: Extracted Groups
docs.text: GeoCore extracts standard AGS groups directly into pandas DataFrames: - HOLE: Borehole metadata, locations, coordinates. - GEOL: Geological stratum descriptions, depths, legend codes. - SCPT: Cone Penetration Test sounding data (\(z\), \(q_c\), \(f_s\), \(u_2\)). - ISPT: Standard Penetration Test field results (\(N\)-values). - SAMP: Soil sample indices, recovery rates, and quality ratings.

docs.title: Python API Usage
docs.text:
from groundhog.general.agsconversion import AGSConverter

# Initialize converter
converter = AGSConverter("borehole_data.ags", encoding="utf8", agsformat="4")

# Extract group as DataFrame
cpt_df = converter.convert_ags_group("SCPT", verbose_keys=True)

docs.title: Deep Foundations & Pile Calculations
docs.text: GeoCore provides comprehensive algorithms for evaluating pile capacity, load distribution, and settlement.

docs.title: 1. LCPC Method (Bustamante & Gianeselli)
docs.text: Calculates pile base and shaft resistance using CPT cone resistance (\(q_c\)).

docs.title: Input Parameters
docs.text:
• Soil Profile: CSV / Excel file containing CPT depth and \(q_c\) data.
  • Pile Diameter (\(D\)): Outside diameter of the pile in meters.
  • Soil Group:
  • Base Group: Group I or Group II.
  • Shaft Group: Group IA, IB, IIA, or IIB.

docs.title: 2. Koppejan Method
docs.text: Calculates pile resistance according to Koppejan's method.

docs.title: Input Parameters
docs.text:
• Soil Profile: CPT dataset with \(q_c\) and total unit weight.
  • Pile Diameter (\(D\)): Diameter in meters.
  • Target Penetration Depth: Depth for detailed resistance construction plots.

docs.title: Eurocode 7 Standards & Factor Calculations
docs.text: GeoCore provides automated statistical parameter selection and partial factor application based on Eurocode 7 (EN 1997-1).

docs.title: Constant Value Profile
docs.text: Selects characteristic values assuming a constant soil property within a layer: - Low: 5% fractile (conservative estimate). - Mean: 95% confidence mean estimate.

docs.title: Linear Trend Analysis
docs.text: Evaluates characteristic values where soil properties vary linearly with depth.

docs.title: 2. Partial Factors (STR / GEO)
docs.text: Select design approaches: - DA1-1 / DA1-2 - DA2 - DA3-1 / DA3-2

docs.title: Shallow Foundations & Settlement Analysis
docs.text: Calculates vertical stress distributions, bearing capacity, and elastic/consolidation settlement for shallow footings.

docs.title: 1. Stress Distributions
docs.text: Calculates vertical stress increases (\(\Delta \sigma_z\)) beneath loaded areas: - Point Load: Boussinesq & Westergaard solutions. - Line Load & Strip Load: Smooth & rough contact stress profiles. - Rectangular Footing: Corner stress integration for flexible & rigid footings. - Circular Footing: Centerline and edge stress profiles.

docs.title: 2. Bearing Capacity
docs.text:
• Eurocode 7 & Vesic: Drained and undrained bearing capacity.
  • Effective Area Calculation:
  • Rectangular footings: \(B' = B - 2e_B\), \(L' = L - 2e_L\)
  • Circular footings: API RP 2GEO effective area geometry.

docs.title: 3. Settlement Analysis
docs.text:
• Elastic Settlement: Janbu, Christian & Carrier elastic strain influence factors.
  • CPT-based Settlement: Schmertmann (1978) strain influence diagram method.
  • Primary Consolidation: \(m_v\) method or \(C_c / C_r\) compression index method.

docs.title: Site Investigation & CPT Processing
docs.text: GeoCore includes dedicated classes and functions for processing Cone Penetration Tests (CPT/PCPT), Standard Penetration Tests (SPT), and soil classification index tests.

docs.title: 1. PCPT Processing Class (PCPTProcessing)
docs.text: The PCPTProcessing class reads CPT soundings (\(z\), \(q_c\), \(f_s\), \(u_2\)) and automatically computes normalized parameters according to Robertson (1990/2009/2016) and Lunne et al. (1997).

docs.title: Computed Parameters
docs.text:
• Normalized Cone Resistance (\(Q_{tn}\))
  • Friction Ratio (\(F_r\))
  • Soil Behavior Type Index (\(I_c\))
  • Undrained Shear Strength (\(s_u\)): $\(s_u = \frac{q_t - \sigma_{v0}}{N_{kt}}\)$
  • Overconsolidation Ratio (OCR)
  • Small-Strain Shear Modulus (\(G_{max}\))

docs.title: 2. Standard Penetration Test (SPTProcessing)
docs.text: Corrects raw field blow counts (\(N\)) to standardized \(N_{60}\) and \((N_1)_{60}\) values: - Overburden correction according to Liao & Whitman (1986) or ISO 22476-3. - Energy ratio correction (\(E_r\)). - Borehole diameter and rod length factors.

docs.title: 3. Laboratory Index Tests
docs.text:
• Plasticity Chart (PlasticityChart): Classifies fine-grained soils on Casagrande's A-line chart (USCS classification).
  • Particle Size Distribution (PSDChart): Generates grain-size distribution curves (\(D_{10}\), \(D_{30}\), \(D_{60}\), \(C_u\), \(C_c\)).
